intro.text: A bridgeman in Bridge Four, one of the bridge crews of Highprince Sadeas's army on the Shattered Plains.
A member of Bridge Four, now helping Rock in the kitchen after an injury left him unable to walk.
A member of Bridge Four who has learned to draw in Stormlight, training with the Windrunners.

items.text: Hobber was sent to the bridge crews after he and his squad got into a drunken brawl in which a man died, though he had probably just gone along with the others.

On Kaladin's first run as bridgeleader, Hobber took an arrow through the thigh. Kaladin dragged him to safety, came back to clean, stitch and bind the wound once the worse injuries were tended, and had him tied to the top of the bridge for the trip back.
Hobber thanked Kaladin warmly for saving him, almost in tears, and told him how Dabbid had sat unmoving all night. Kaladin promised to bring him food while he healed.

Within a few weeks, helped by the food and antiseptic Kaladin found, Hobber limped out to join the crew's first pot of stew. He was soon walking without a crutch, and Lopen recruited him and Dabbid to carry water for the crew.

When Bridge Four decided to get tattoos, Hobber, the first to believe in Kaladin, went first. Told the glyphs meant "freedom", he asked for "Bridge Four" to be added, since Bridge Four had freed him. The others asked for the same, and the crew insisted that Shen be tattooed too.

Warned by Syl of darkness in the palace, Kaladin sent Hobber and Beld ahead to scout a way out. They ran into Szeth, who killed Beld and cut Hobber's legs, leaving them grey and dead. Hobber wept that he was useless, but Kaladin insisted he would always be Bridge Four and carried him back.
Hobber took up a new role helping Rock in the kitchen, serving the men from a stump they made for him, his grey legs covered with a blanket.

After Bridge Four moved to Urithiru, Hobber went with them to the Shattered Plains for Windrunner training, still working as Rock's assistant. Kaladin handed him a gemstone and asked him to try breathing in its Stormlight, telling him that being a Radiant was about heart, and Hobber's was the best of them.

As Hobber stared at the gem, windspren gathered and his fist began to glow. Kaladin had the bridgemen give him all their gemstones, and Hobber cried that he could feel his toes again. Drehy and Peet helped him down, and he stood on his own while the crew celebrated.
As more men took to the skies, Hobber admitted he feared he couldn't keep up, which led others to share their own fears. Rock reminded them they could be alone together, which comforted them.
Hobber settled into guard duty with the rest of Bridge Four. Guarding Dalinar and Navani at a meeting, he and Leyten said they liked boring days, because it meant nobody was trying to kill them.

appearance.text: A lean, round-faced man with short black hair and a gap between his teeth. A tattoo on his forehead covers his slave's brand.

personality.text: Cheerful and openly grateful, Hobber keeps smiling even through pain and was the first of the bridgemen to believe in Kaladin.
Hobber never wavers in his devotion to Kaladin, who rescued him. He follows the Passions.
